use: The town family's placement stinger: a short tonal cue layered over the place-rumble and place-thunk when one of the house_cluster and bakery tiles settles after a placement or a replace, positional at the tile, on the effects bus, at PLACE_STINGER.level (0.45) times the thunk's placement level, or on demand (hexWorld.audio.play). The runtime routes it (stingerFamily and PLACE_STINGER in web/ui/src/audio-mix.ts), so it lists no event.

provider.name: ElevenLabs
provider.subscription: ElevenLabs Starter (paid, owner account; tier from GET /v1/user/subscription)

prompt: Gentle game placement stinger for a village house: one soft warm note on a small brass handbell struck gently with a felt mallet, cosy, with a short ring. Soft felt-mallet attack, warm and rounded, quiet and friendly, in the family of a cosy wooden game interface. The notes ring briefly and fade to silence within about 0.7 seconds, with silence after. No drum hit, no click, no reverb tail, no voices, no other music.

parameters.text: Gentle game placement stinger for a village house: one soft warm note on a small brass handbell struck gently with a felt mallet, cosy, with a short ring. master.format: WAV float32 (target/, not committed; rebuilt by make audio-master)

runtime.command: ffmpeg -nostdin -y -v error -i target/audio-master/sfx/place-stinger-town.wav -map_metadata -1 -fflags +bitexact -flags:a +bitexact -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a libopus -b:a 64k -vbr on -compression_level 10 -application audio -frame_duration 20 assets/audio/sfx/place-stinger-town.webm
